title: Version bumps, packaging fixes, publish 16 crates
description: Semver bumps (wolfcrypt 0.3.0, wrapper 2.0.0, ...). Unanchored include globs had pulled C submodule files into packages. Added vendored features to wolftpm2/wolftpm2-sys/wolfhsm. Publish: cargo publish --workspace --features 'wolfcrypt-sys/vendored wolftpm2/vendored' with WOLFHSM_SRC/WOLFTPM_SRC set; crates.io allows about 1 new crate name per 10 minutes.
